memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the internal organs and the meat from the head. You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep, for the Lord your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the Lord's name always. - Deut 18:3-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Since the Levites had no land to farm, God arranged for their needs through the offerings of the people. The priests received a share of the sacrifices and the firstfruits of grain, wine, oil, and wool. God's servants would be cared for by God's people. Those who gave themselves fully to ministering before the Lord would not be left to fend for themselves.

Notice the reason given, "the Lord your God has chosen them." Their provision flowed from God's choosing and calling. The people's generosity toward the Levites was really an act of honouring the God who had set them apart to serve.

This principle carries into the New Testament. Paul taught that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel, just as the temple servants shared in the offerings (1 Cor 9:13-14). God cares that those who devote themselves to spiritual ministry are supported by His people. But there is a wider encouragement here too. God provides for His servants, often through the generosity of others. When we give to support gospel work, we share in it and honour the God who calls His workers. Are you playing your part in supporting those who serve the Lord, and do you trust God to provide for His own?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How can you support those who serve God's people?
2. Do you see giving as sharing in gospel work?
3. Where do you need to trust God's provision more fully?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for providing for Your servants through Your people. Make me generous toward gospel work and trusting in Your care. Amen.
